title: 2  Making the table
text:
2.4 Exercise 2

# Calculate the average pay out if you play the game once.

set.seed(124)  #For reproducibility

Reel2<-1:6
probs<- c( 7, 5, 3, 6, 9, 20 )/50
spin<-sample(Reel2, size=1, prob=probs)
winnings<- c(2, 2.5, 8, 4, 2.5, 0)
originalpayout<- winnings[spin]
originalpayout

[1] 0

spinsEx2 <- sample(Reel2, size = 10000, replace = TRUE, prob = probs)
#Get payouts
payoutsEx2 <- winnings[spinsEx2]

#Estimate the average payout if you play the game once.
est_avg_payout <- mean(payoutsEx2)
est_avg_payout

[1] 1.93995

#Theoretical expected payout
true_avg_payout <- sum(probs*winnings)
true_avg_payout

[1] 1.94

title: 2  Making the table
text:
2.5 Exercise 3

set.seed(125)  #For reproducibility

Reel2<-1:6
probs<- c( 7, 5, 3, 6, 9, 20 )/50
spin<-sample(Reel2, size=1, prob=probs)
winnings<- c(2, 2.5, 8, 4, 2.5, 0)

spinsEx3 <- sample(Reel2, size = 10, replace = TRUE, prob = probs)
#Get payouts
payoutsEx3 <- winnings[spinsEx3]
payoutsEx3

 [1] 0.0 0.0 0.0 8.0 8.0 2.5 0.0 2.0 2.0 0.0

#Total payout
cum_payout <- cumsum(payoutsEx3)
cum_payout

 [1]  0.0  0.0  0.0  8.0 16.0 18.5 18.5 20.5 22.5 22.5

avgpayout <- mean(payoutsEx3)
avgpayout

[1] 2.25

#Histogram showing cumulative paypout
hist(cum_payout, 
     main= "Histogram of Accumulated Payouts over 10 games",
     xlab= "Cumulative Payout",
     ylab= "Frequency",
     col= "blue",
     border= "black",
     breaks= 5)







boxplot(cum_payout, 
        main = "Boxplot of Accumulated Payouts",
        ylab = "Cumulative Payout",
        col = "lightgreen"
        )







#Histogram showing paypout frequency
hist(payoutsEx3, 
     main = "Histogram of Payouts over 10 games",
     xlab = "Payouts",
     ylab = "Frequency",
     col = "lightblue",
     border = "black",
     breaks = 5)







boxplot(payoutsEx3, 
        main = "Boxplot of Payouts over 10 games",
        ylab = "Cumulative Payout",
        col = "green"
        )







#For accumulated payouts over 10 games
meanAccPayout <- mean(cum_payout)
medAccPayout <- median(cum_payout)
fivenumAccPayout<-fivenum(cum_payout)

summarystat <- data.frame(Statistics = c("Mean","Median","Minimum","Q1","Q2","Q3","Maximum"),Values=c(meanAccPayout,medAccPayout,fivenumAccPayout))
print(summarystat)
